data.title: Thai Airways CEO ousted over flood mishaps
data.description: The board of directors of Thai Airways International Public Co Ltd on Friday dismissed Chief Executive Officer Chai Eamsiri following the widespread mismanagement of flight schedules and severe baggage backlogs during heavy flooding in the capital that started Sept 25.

data.title: World powers gather in Pacific to chart climate battle
data.description: WELLINGTON - World powers are flying delegates to the Pacific to haggle over the fight against global warming, and to see the plight of island nations surrounded by a rising ocean.

data.title: Taiwan receives its first US-made F-16V fighter jets
data.description: TAITUNG (TAIWAN) - Taiwan received on Friday its first F-16V fighter jets made by the United States, as the island democracy upgrades its military capabilities to deter a potential Chinese attack.

data.title: Hotelier returns 100,000 baht in euros to French tourist
data.description: The owner of an accommodation near Phuket airport successfully returned a bundle of euro banknotes left in a wardrobe, estimated to be worth about 100,000 baht, to a French tourist on Friday, receiving thanks and a 100-baht tip.

data.title: TPC unites 100-plus organisations at AT ONE IMPACT WEEK 2026
data.description: TPC and NO.17 Foundation brought together more than 100 organisations worldwide to announce new strategic collaborations to advance the Well-being Economy, driving change across climate restoration, land, food, ocean, finance, investment and human development. Held in Singapore for its second year, AT ONE IMPACT WEEK 2026 welcomed more than 5,000 participants from across Asia.

data.title: ONE Championship: Eersel, Jarvis make weight for lightweight Muay Thai title rematch
data.description: George Jarvis’s second shot at Regian Eersel’s ONE Championship lightweight Muay Thai world title is set for Friday night after both cleared weight and hydration for The Inner Circle 33.

data.title: Baggage claims to be moved to new location, transport ministry promises Thai Airways compensation
data.description: Thai Airways International (Thai) will move bag collection to a new place on Saturday as the Transport Ministry has pledged financial compensation for flyers affected by flight and baggage chaos after flooding paralysed the airline.

data.title: Huawei supports employees during flooding, delivers relief supplies to communities
data.description: Bangkok, September 30, 2026 – Huawei Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. announced that, following heavy rainfall and flash flooding across Bangkok from Sept 25-27, 2026, several areas continue to experience high water levels, causing significant disruption to travel. A few Huawei employees have also been affected by the flooding. In response, the company established a dedicated emergency coordination team to provide urgent assistance, including arranging boats and delivering food to employees affected by the situation.

data.title: Central Pattana Wins 3 PropertyGuru Awards, Top Honours for BAAN NINYA KRABI
data.description: Central Pattana’s President & CEO is named Real Estate Personality of the Year 2026, recognising his leadership in the property sector and his vision for drawing on the company’s mixed-use development expertise to create homes, shape cities and enhance quality of life.

data.title: Lula, Bolsonaro trade scandal fire in final scramble for votes
data.description: BRASíLIA - Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his election rival Flavio Bolsonaro are leaving no controversy unturned in their last-ditch efforts to discredit each other and win over voters ahead of Sunday's nail-biter election.

data.title: Return of swarming moth spectacle has Australia in a flutter
data.description: SYDNEY - Moth swarms so thick they can blot out the stars are fluttering across Australia, heralding a migratory spectacle unseen since the creature's brush with extinction nearly 10 years ago.

data.title: Embankment collapses, inundating more than 500 homes in Chai Nat
data.description: A flood-control sandbag embankment collapsed last night, sending a surge of water into more than 500 households in Sapphaya district of Chai Nat province, leaving residents little time to save their belongings.

data.title: Bhumjaithai flood kitchen gets high ratings on GrabFood
data.description: The Bhumjaithai Party’s flood-relief kitchen had earned a 4.8 out of 5 rating on food delivery platform GrabFood as of Friday. Most reviewers praised the hot food and generous portions, though some raised concerns about MSG (monosodium glutamate) and packaging.

data.title: Plankton bloom turns Thai island waters a bright, smelly green
data.description: CHON BURI — The sea ‌off Thailand's popular tourist island of Ko Lan turned a bright, pungent green this week as heavy rains and floods helped spark a plankton bloom that kept some swimmers on shore.

data.title: Not-so-brave new world: virtual taekwondo makes Asian Games debut
data.description: TOYOHASHI (JAPAN) - Taekwondo dates back more than 2,000 years, but on Friday at the Asian Games the Korean martial art stepped into a not-so-brave future where nobody gets hurt: virtual taekwondo.

data.title: Nepal's grim DNA puzzle to identify flood dead
data.description: NUWAKOT (NEPAL) - Clutching a photograph of his missing son, Rajesh Ram is pinning his hopes on deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) testing -- like thousands of others desperately seeking relatives swept away by Nepal's catastrophic Himalayan floods.

data.title: Arab Israeli candidate drops out of election race
data.description: JERUSALEM — Arab Israeli politician Sami Abu Shehadeh withdrew his candidacy on Thursday from October's parliamentary election after Israel's Supreme Court indicated a majority of its judges supported barring him from the race.

data.title: New housing supply grows faster than sales in northeastern Thailand
data.description: Unsold homes total 13,421 in five provinces, while second-hand properties account for more than 70% of housing transfers in the Northeast.

data.title: IRPC board appoints Sirimet Leephakorn as CEO
data.description: The IRPC Plc board of directors has appointed Sirimet Leephakorn as the company’s new chief executive officer and president, effective from Oct 1, 2026.

data.title: PM ignores  calls to fire  Chadchart
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul rejected calls to remove Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt from his post as the government urged agencies to focus on draining floodwaters and restoring affected areas rather than political criticism.

data.title: Experts urge extra support for elderly
data.description: Thailand needs to strengthen income, healthcare, care and age-friendly systems as the proportion of elderly people is projected to reach nearly one-third of the population by 2042, experts said.

data.title: BMA weighs up car-free days
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) may introduce one or two car-free days a week to encourage residents to rely less on private vehicles, as traffic congestion costs the capital an estimated 60 million baht a day.

data.title: Thai Airways to resume normal flight schedules from Saturday
data.description: Thai Airways International (Thai) will return to its normal flight operation mode on Saturday after severe floods in greater Bangkok have maimed the airline as it cancelled some services that stranded passengers and baggage.

data.title: Viral anti-vax posts weaponise Philippine inoculation fears
data.description: MANILA - When Jenette Torres Odena's three-year-old son fell ill days after receiving a jab as part of a Philippine vaccination drive, his photograph quickly spread on Facebook alongside claims the inoculation had killed him.

data.title: Israel courts Europe's far right, finding friends but also unease
data.description: JERUSALEM - Facing growing isolation over the war in Gaza, Israel is increasingly allying itself with Europe's far right, despite some parties' legacies of antisemitism.

data.title: Government launches insurance scheme for 30 million homes
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has launched a nationwide disaster insurance scheme covering some 30 million households.

data.title: Saudi coalition accuses Houthis of drone attack on Medina
data.description: RIYADH (SAUDI ARABIA) - Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis struck an electricity distribution station in the holy city of Medina in Saudi Arabia, the Saudi-led coalition said on Thursday, sparking strong condemnation from the Muslim world.

data.title: Ronaldo's Portugal future in doubt after walkout
data.description: COPENHAGEN - The international future of Portugal superstar Cristiano Ronaldo hung in the balance after the 41-year-old walked out on the squad after learning that he would not start the game against Denmark on Thursday.

data.title: Ireland game interrupted twice by Gaza protests
data.description: DUBLIN - The Nations League football match between Ireland and Austria in Dublin on Thursday was twice briefly interrupted by demonstrations in support of Palestine.

data.title: Portugal edge Denmark in Ronaldo's absence
data.description: COPENHAGEN - Portugal put the controversy surrounding Cristiano Ronaldo's departure to one side as they edged Denmark 4-2 in the Uefa Nations League on Thursday.
